cond_0001.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. This position develops visualization solutions using the Power BI product suite, with emphasis on front-end UX components.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop BI solutions using the Microsoft Power BI product in support of a Business Intelligence solutions group.
Provide end-to-end technical expertise and knowledge in support of architecture, design, development, and security using the Power BI product.
Support overall project implementation of large volume applications in Power BI, leveraging product-specific design patterns specifically designed to support datasets with hundreds of millions of records.
Communicate effectively at all levels of the organization, in both written and oral formats.
Primarily responsible for designing, developing, modifying, and maintaining dashboards and reports.
Works with stakeholders to identify trends, aggregate data and build visually appealing reports in Microsoft Power BI.
Able to apply data visualization best practices to construct, steward, curate, and leverage end-to-end digital content for programmatic dashboards.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related Information Technology discipline.
5+ Years of IT experience with 3+ years of hands-on experience developing visualization solutions using the Power BI product.
Experience in Data Visualizations and dashboard development – Power BI UX, data modeling, and ETL.
Experience in chart functions such as aggregations, ranking and set analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of Big Data and strategies for good problem-solving and communication skills.
Knowledge of full Power BI tools suite – Power BI desktop, Power BI report server, Power Apps, Power BI report Builder, Power BI Gateways, Power BI Embedded, and Power BI mobile.

cond_0199.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. This position develops visualization solutions using the Power BI product suite, with emphasis on front-end UX components.
cond_0199.responsibilities:
Develop BI solutions using the Microsoft Power BI product in support of a Business Intelligence solutions group.
Provide end-to-end technical expertise and knowledge in support of architecture, design, development, and security using the Power BI product.
Support overall project implementation of large volume applications in Power BI, leveraging product-specific design patterns specifically designed to support datasets with hundreds of millions of records.
Communicate effectively at all levels of the organization, in both written and oral formats.
Primarily responsible for designing, developing, modifying, and maintaining dashboards and reports.
Works with stakeholders to identify trends, aggregate data and build visually appealing reports in Microsoft Power BI.
Able to apply data visualization best practices to construct, steward, curate, and leverage end-to-end digital content for programmatic dashboards.
cond_0199.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related Information Technology discipline.
5+ Years of IT experience with 3+ years of hands-on experience developing visualization solutions using the Power BI product.
Experience in Data Visualizations and dashboard development – Power BI UX, data modeling, and ETL.
Experience in chart functions such as aggregations, ranking and set analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of Big Data and strategies for good problem-solving and communication skills.
Knowledge of full Power BI tools suite – Power BI desktop, Power BI report server, Power Apps, Power BI report Builder, Power BI Gateways, Power BI Embedded, and Power BI mobile.
cond_0199.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0342.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. This position works on visualization solutions using the Power BI product suite, with emphasis on front-end UX components.
cond_0342.responsibilities:
Collaborate with the Business Intelligence solutions group to develop BI solutions using Microsoft Power BI.
Work alongside architects and engineers to support architecture, design, development, and security using the Power BI product.
Coordinate with the team to support project implementation of large volume applications in Power BI, leveraging design patterns built for datasets with hundreds of millions of records.
Communicate effectively at all levels of the organization, in both written and oral formats.
Work with the team to design, develop, modify, and maintain dashboards and reports.
Partner with stakeholders to identify trends, aggregate data, and build visually appealing reports in Microsoft Power BI.
Apply data visualization best practices to construct, steward, curate, and share end-to-end digital content for programmatic dashboards.
cond_0342.requirements:
Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related Information Technology discipline.
5+ Years of IT experience with 3+ years of hands-on experience developing visualization solutions using the Power BI product.
Experience in Data Visualizations and dashboard development – Power BI UX, data modeling, and ETL.
Experience in chart functions such as aggregations, ranking and set analysis.
Understanding of Big Data and strategies for good problem-solving and communication skills.
Knowledge of full Power BI tools suite – Power BI desktop, Power BI report server, Power Apps, Power BI report Builder, Power BI Gateways, Power BI Embedded, and Power BI mobile.

This position develops visualization solutions using the Power BI product suite, with emphasis on front-end UX components.
cond_0462.responsibilities:
Develop BI solutions using the Microsoft Power BI product in support of a Business Intelligence solutions group.
Provide end-to-end technical expertise and knowledge in support of architecture, design, development, and security using the Power BI product.
Support overall project implementation of large volume applications in Power BI, leveraging product-specific design patterns specifically designed to support datasets with hundreds of millions of records.
Communicate effectively at all levels of the organization, in both written and oral formats.
Primarily responsible for designing, developing, modifying, and maintaining dashboards and reports.
Works with stakeholders to identify trends, aggregate data and build visually appealing reports in Microsoft Power BI.
Able to apply data visualization best practices to construct, steward, curate, and leverage end-to-end digital content for programmatic dashboards.
cond_0462.requirements:
Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related Information Technology discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of IT experience, with ideally 3 years of hands-on experience developing visualization solutions using the Power BI product, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with Data Visualizations and dashboard development – Power BI UX, data modeling, and ETL.
Familiarity with chart functions such as aggregations, ranking and set analysis.
Background in Big Data and a willingness to apply problem-solving and communication skills in practice.
Working knowledge of the Power BI tools suite – Power BI desktop, Power BI report server, Power Apps, Power BI report Builder, Power BI Gateways, Power BI Embedded, and Power BI mobile.
